constraints.name: activity_events_actor_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (actor_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: activity_events_org_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (org_id) REFERENCES orgs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: client_contacts_client_fkey

constraints.name: clients_creator_membership_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (org_id, created_by) REFERENCES memberships(org_id, user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: clients_document_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((document IS NULL) OR ((person_type IS NOT NULL) AND (((person_type = 'individual'::text) AND (document ~ '^[0-9]{11}$'::text)) OR ((person_type = 'company'::text) AND (document ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{12}[0-9]{2}$'::text))))))

constraints.name: clients_org_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (org_id) REFERENCES orgs(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: clients_owner_membership_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (org_id, owner_user_id) REFERENCES memberships(org_id, user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: memberships_org_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (org_id) REFERENCES orgs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: memberships_role_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (role_id) REFERENCES roles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: memberships_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: projects_client_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (org_id, client_id) REFERENCES clients(org_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: projects_completed_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'completed'::text) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (progress IS NOT NULL) AND (progress = 100)) OR ((status <> 'completed'::text) AND (completed_at IS NULL))))

constraints.name: projects_creator_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (org_id, created_by) REFERENCES memberships(org_id, user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: projects_dates_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((start_date IS NULL) OR (due_date IS NULL) OR (due_date >= start_date)))

constraints.name: projects_org_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (org_id) REFERENCES orgs(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: projects_owner_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (org_id, owner_user_id) REFERENCES memberships(org_id, user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: role_permissions_permission_key_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (permission_key) REFERENCES permissions(key) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: role_permissions_role_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (role_id) REFERENCES roles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: roles_org_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (org_id) REFERENCES orgs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

policies.qual:
((org_id = atlaz.current_org_id()) AND atlaz.is_member() AND (((entity_type = 'client'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM clients c
  WHERE ((c.org_id = activity_events.org_id) AND (c.id = activity_events.entity_id))))) OR ((entity_type = 'project'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM projects p
  WHERE ((p.org_id = activity_events.org_id) AND (p.id = activity_events.entity_id))))) OR (entity_type <> ALL (ARRAY['client'::text, 'project'::text]))))

((org_id = atlaz.current_org_id()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM clients c
  WHERE ((c.org_id = client_contacts.org_id) AND (c.id = client_contacts.client_id)))))

((org_id = atlaz.current_org_id()) AND atlaz.has_permission('client:read'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (memberships m
     JOIN roles r ON (((r.id = m.role_id) AND (r.org_id = m.org_id))))
  WHERE ((m.org_id = clients.org_id) AND (m.user_id = atlaz.current_user_id()) AND m.is_active AND (m.scope = 'org'::text)))))

((org_id = atlaz.current_org_id()) AND atlaz.has_permission('project:read'::text) AND atlaz.has_permission('client:read'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ((memberships m
     JOIN roles r ON (((r.id = m.role_id) AND (r.org_id = m.org_id))))
     JOIN users u ON (((u.id = m.user_id) AND u.is_active)))
  WHERE ((m.org_id = projects.org_id) AND (m.user_id = atlaz.current_user_id()) AND m.is_active AND (m.scope = 'org'::text)))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM clients c
  WHERE ((c.org_id = projects.org_id) AND (c.id = projects.client_id)))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM roles r
  WHERE ((r.id = role_permissions.role_id) AND (r.org_id = atlaz.current_org_id()))))

(atlaz.has_permission('team:manage'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM roles r
  WHERE ((r.id = role_permissions.role_id) AND (r.org_id = atlaz.current_org_id())))))
policies.with_check:
(atlaz.has_permission('team:manage'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM roles r
  WHERE ((r.id = role_permissions.role_id) AND (r.org_id = atlaz.current_org_id())))))

policies.qual:
((auth_user_id = auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (memberships m1
     JOIN memberships m2 ON ((m2.org_id = m1.org_id)))
  WHERE ((m1.user_id = atlaz.current_user_id()) AND (m2.user_id = users.id)))))
